description: Implementation of Salsa20 core function and XOR stream in Go, including core cryptographic operations and utility functions.

methods.name: core
methods.description: Applies the Salsa20 core function to 16-byte input with 32-byte key and 16-byte constant, producing a 64-byte output.

methods.name: genericXORKeyStream
methods.description: Performs XOR stream encryption using Salsa20, with a fallback implementation when no assembly is available.
